items.content: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.
items.contentSnippet: Learn how OpenAI and Ironclad are training and evaluating AI agents on complex contracting workflows to advance computer use for professional work.

summaries.zh: OpenAI与Ironclad合作，通过训练和评估AI代理在复杂合同流程中的表现，推动专业工作领域的计算机应用发展。此举旨在提升AI在合同管理等方面的实际应用能力，优化工作流程。
summaries.en: OpenAI and Ironclad are collaborating to train and evaluate AI agents on complex contracting workflows, aiming to enhance computer use in professional settings. Their efforts focus on developing AI systems capable of handling intricate tasks within the contracting domain. This partnership seeks to improve efficiency and accuracy in AI-driven workflows, particularly in business and legal contexts. The project underscores the growing integration of advanced AI technologies into professional operations.

items.title: Atlassian and OpenAI expand partnership to turn enterprise knowledge into action

items.contentSnippet: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to connect frontier models with enterprise knowledge and help teams plan, build, and deliver work.

summaries.en: Atlassian and OpenAI are expanding their partnership to integrate frontier AI models with enterprise knowledge. The collaboration aims to assist teams in planning, building, and delivering work more effectively. The enhanced partnership leverages AI to transform organizational data into actionable insights, streamlining workflows and improving productivity within businesses.

items.title: The eternal complement
items.content: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.
items.contentSnippet: Advanced AI may matter most for the routine work behind breakthrough ideas. Explore why execution could shape the next economy and the pace of progress.

summaries.zh: 文章标题为《永恒的补充》。内容指出，高级人工智能对突破性想法背后的常规工作至关重要。探讨执行如何塑造下一经济形态和进步速度。
summaries.en: Advanced AI is crucial for handling the routine work behind breakthrough ideas, potentially shaping the next economy and the speed of progress. The focus is on execution, which may be the key factor in future advancements.
